about:
AIROS Medical, Inc. was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Norristown, Pennsylvania. The company develops compression therapy devices and garments for patients with lymphedema, venous disorders, and related conditions.

The company designs and manufactures pneumatic compression systems for home use, including the AIROS 6 and AIROS 8 devices for lymphedema and chronic venous insufficiency, and the ARTAIRA arterial compression device for peripheral arterial disease. It also produces a range of compression garments for upper extremity, lower extremity, and truncal treatment, with the truncal line recently expanded to more inclusive sizes. All devices are FDA-cleared.

AIROS Medical serves patients directly as well as durable medical equipment (DME) suppliers and clinicians. Its therapies address lymphedema, venous insufficiency, breast cancer-related lymphedema, lipedema, and peripheral arterial disease. The company’s website invites inquiries from patients, DME suppliers seeking alternative compression products, and clinicians looking for patient solutions.

The company emphasizes a collaborative development approach, stating that its team of medical technology designers, engineers, quality control experts, and clinical advisors work together to drive positive patient outcomes. It also highlights that its devices blend advanced medical technology with clinical direction drawn from decades of industry experience.
